plan: docs/v4lite_plan.md; selection results in results/v4lite (development data only)
setup: as preregistration v3: T1 (bigFlows), tree3 (core s11 + access s12/s13, tables 3,500, idle 10 s, all monitored), benign scale 0.5, one controller, 300 s, attack at 50 s, new-connection probe every 0.5 s

system.name: ensguard-v4lite
changes_vs_v3: detector: federated CatBoost only (D1-D3, model seed 0, the v3 CatBoost members), tau at 0.1 % on own validation benign (T1 0.622)
block rule: evictions >= 50 and >= 3 x max(median host, 10) and evicted / held entries in 10 s >= 0.2
score only entries whose counters or install time changed
system.unchanged: evict >= tau, block 60 s doubling to 240 s, PortGuard full mode, host identity

development_check: seeds 4134-4136, A4 + benign (results/testbed_prereg_v4lite/dev_check.md); no setting changed after it
test: one-sided exact sign test on the 15 paired attack runs (same variant, same seed); a tie counts against the hypothesis; Holm within each family; alpha 0.05

hypotheses.H1: ensguard-v4lite harms fewer benign flows (benign_harmed_pct) than ensguard v3
hypotheses.H2: ensguard-v4lite has a shorter mean decision time per poll (decision_ms mean) than ensguard v3
hypotheses.H3: ensguard-v4lite loses fewer benign first packets (benign_packet_in_lost_pct) than ensguard v3
hypotheses.H4: ensguard-v4lite harms fewer benign flows than each of dms-btt and ftmaster (Holm over the 2)
hypotheses.H5: no benign host is blocked in any of ensguard-v4lite's 20 runs (descriptive)
hypotheses.H6: benign-only runs of ensguard-v4lite: mean harm <= 0.5 % and mean lost first packets <= 1 % (descriptive)

reported_without_test: attack share (avg, max) at s11-s13, seconds at the limit, Packet-In, Table-Full, probe success and connect time, hosts blocked, CPU and memory, per variant
validity: a run is valid if the controller logs to >= 90 % of the duration and the wall time is <= 1.5 x + 60 s (matrix_e5.sh); an invalid run is rerun once with the same seed and reported
